topic: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 on Ukrainian train station

en.headline: Russian drone strike on Dnipro station kills at least 14, some say 13
en.body: According to Reuters and CNN, the strike killed at least 14 people. Other outlets, including FAZ and Der Spiegel, report 13 deaths.

fr.headline: Attaque de drone russe sur la gare de Dnipro tue au moins 14 personnes, certains disent 13
fr.body: Selon Reuters et CNN, l'attaque a fait au moins 14 morts. D'autres médias, dont la FAZ et Der Spiegel, rapportent 13 décès.

de.headline: Russischer Drohnenangriff auf den Dnipro-Bahnhof tötet mindestens 14, einige sagen 13
de.body: Laut Reuters und CNN starb bei dem Angriff mindestens 14 Personen. Andere Medien, darunter FAZ und Der Spiegel, berichten von 13 Todesfällen.

it.headline: Attacco aereo russo su stazione di Dnipro uccide almeno 14 persone, alcuni dicono 13
it.body: Secondo Reuters e CNN, l'attacco ha ucciso almeno 14 persone. Altri media, tra cui FAZ e Der Spiegel, riportano 13 morti.

es.headline: El ataque con dron ruso a la estación de Dnipro mata a al menos 14 personas, algunos dicen 13
es.body: Según Reuters y CNN, el ataque mató a al menos 14 personas. Otros medios, entre ellos FAZ y Der Spiegel, informan 13 fallecidos.

ko.headline: 러시아 드론 공격이 드니프로 역에서 최소 14명 사망
ko.body: 로이터와 CNN에 따르면 이번 공격으로 최소 14명이 사망했다고 한다. FAZ와 Der Spiegel 등 다른 매체는 13명 사망이라고 보도했다.

ja.headline: ロシアのドローン攻撃でドニプロ駅に少なくとも14人死亡、別の報道では13人
ja.body: ロイターとCNNによると、攻撃で少なくとも14人が死亡した。FAZやDer Spiegelを含む他の報道機関は13人の死亡と報じている。

zh.headline: 俄罗斯无人机袭击第聂伯罗站至少造成14人死亡，部分媒体称13人
zh.body: 据路透社和CNN报道，此次袭击至少造成14人死亡。其他媒体，包括《法兰克福汇报》（FAZ）和《明镜周刊》（Der Spiegel），则称死亡人数为13人。

pt.headline: Ataque de drone russo na estação Dnipro mata pelo menos 14, alguns dizem 13
pt.body: De acordo com a Reuters e a CNN, o ataque matou pelo menos 14 pessoas. Outras fontes, incluindo a FAZ e o Der Spiegel, registam 13 mortes.

en.title: Russian drone strike kills at least 14 at Dnipro train station
en.dek: A Russian drone attack on a Ukrainian rail platform in Dnipro on 29 October 2026 killed at least 14 people, with some reports citing 13 deaths.
facts: Russian drone strike on Dnipro station on 29 October 2026.
At least 14 people were killed according to Reuters and CNN.
13 deaths were reported by FAZ and Der Spiegel.
The strike targeted a rail platform in central Ukraine.
The attack was carried out by a Russian drone.
body: According to Reuters and CNN, a Russian drone strike on Dnipro station on 29 October 2026 killed at least 14 people. The strike targeted a rail platform in central Ukraine.
FAZ and Der Spiegel reported a death toll of 13. The discrepancy reflects differing reports from independent outlets.
The attack was carried out by a Russian drone. The drone was launched from Russian-controlled territory.
The incident occurred in Dnipro, a city in central Ukraine. Dnipro is a major rail hub in the region.
The strike is part of the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine. No further details about the motive were provided by the outlets.
Ukrainian authorities have not issued a statement according to the reports. The incident has been reported by multiple independent news outlets.
en.context: Dnipro is a city in central Ukraine.
